Can only swap to pathfinder when you're strong and don't notice the defense/damage loss from swapping off of deadeye. Pathfinder is pure utility for cannot be slowed/sprint knockdown immune.

Every small node if possible should be 5% increased damage from Traveller's Wisdom (some nodes will need to stay as attribute for requirements). Legacy of Greymake helps with attributes.

Pathfinder Ascendancy nodes
Relentless Pursuit/ Running Assault/ Path Seeker/ Traveller's Wisdom
(Doesn't matter which patch you take for path seeker, just taking it for the extra skill points.
